$comment: UmActually — Azure DevOps Marketplace extension manifest. IN DEVELOPMENT — do not publish to the public marketplace until the README/overview.md and license-terms.md are updated, a real publisher ID is registered, and the package has been tested by sideloading into a private organization. See ado-extension/README.md for the full pre-publish checklist.
name: UmActually PR Review (Dev Preview)
description: Provider-agnostic AI PR review for Azure DevOps. Wires the UmActually CLI into Azure Pipelines so every PR gets a verified-facts + confidence-filter review with inline threads. Supports any OpenAI-protocol, Anthropic, or GitHub Copilot endpoint — including dual-protocol gateways.
$scopesNotes: Minimum required scopes: build_execute (queue + run the review pipeline), code + code_write (read PR diff + metadata, post review comments), threads_full (post PR threads). All four are non-elevated scopes for an extension that reads code and posts review feedback. Do NOT request 'user_impersonation' — the task only needs pipeline-scoped identity. The build service identity is what posts the threads, not a user.

contributions.description: Build/Release task that runs the UmActually CLI against the current pipeline's PR context. Posts inline review threads to the Azure DevOps PR.

$flagsNotes: When ready to publish: remove 'Preview' from galleryFlags, set the 'public' flag (or 'galleryFlags: [Public]'), and replace 'REPLACE_WITH_PUBLISHER_ID' with the real publisher ID. Until then, sideload only — see the ADO docs for 'tfx extension share' and 'tfx extension publish'.
